answer: Each new agent identity must complete a serial delay proof of 12 minutes before it can claim rewards. The proof generates a network ripple that propagates only after the full delay, so a sybil attacker creating N identities pays N*12 minutes of sequential compute that cannot be parallelized. An honest single sparrow-like agent incurs only one delay, while the attacker’s attempt to operate in sable darkness fails as the cumulative ripple exposes the mass of fake seats at once.
